name: alignment_targets
description: Discover alignment targets from explicit seeds and transitive current authoring/source-scan references. Retains seeds first and dependent feature scene order, suppresses duplicates, excludes raw mesh/point-cloud dependents, and reports locked or unsupported targets and the 32-object limit. Read-only: review entityIds before passing them to alignment_preview/apply. Uses the same operation as Include dependent features in the alignment panel. Native complete controller and all authoring relationship types remain unfinished. Includes sibling outputs of selected active authoring features before dependent discovery; groupIds identifies those siblings. Retained authoring identities and links remain discoverable after baking.

name: mesh_process
description: Execute scan tools, repair, smooth, reduce, segment, registration, scan editing, selection morphology or section extraction. Source geometry is owned by the workspace. Segmentation objects retain their classifications and fits; responses expose segmentClassifications in segment order. Point clouds support pointCloudEdit deletion, extraction, point-count or voxel simplification, smoothing and radius-connected selection. Whole-cloud paired, ICP and global registration preserve point type and native accumulated pose over immutable local buffers, with bounded CPU transforms; omit selectionOnly for point-cloud registration. Result diagnostics expose pointCloudPose and execution details.

refineSurface.description: Refine a raw indexed moving scan after native coarse registration using targetId. The fixed target may be an indexed scan or exact CAD with cached kernel face triangulations. CAD conversion evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at cached UV nodes and preserves the BRep. Target records are copied without welding and normals regenerated before refinement. Original landmark vertex seeds grow to 3000 faces or stability. Radius 3 mm. Coarse and delta retain separate Float32 stages.

endBoundary.description: Bridge destination boundary index from inventory, including closed loops and open chains. The indices array identifies exactly one start boundary. Omit to bridge within that same boundary; start/end identify local edge indices. Open paths have pointCount-1 edges.

strength.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 0.5; boundary smoothing defaults to 0.3.

iterations.description: Selected-area smoothing defaults to 6 passes; boundary smoothing defaults to 3. Explicit values override these defaults.

neighborRadius.description: Point neighborhood radius in mm; default 0.5.

deviation.description: Maximum cumulative displacement from original sample, mm; default 0.05.

seedVertices.description: Optional original indexed source vertex IDs. Grow a native one-ring region until at least 3000 faces or unchanged count; refine all selected visible region vertices without sampling. Existing selected face flags participate in the stopping count. Whole scan moves.

workerCount.description: Logical native lanes. Preserve this value when comparing serial and parallel output.

parallel.description: Use a bounded two-worker CPU pool when admitted; false evaluates the same logical lanes serially.

targetIds.description: Ordered fixed indexed mesh targets for nativeRefine only; mutually exclusive with targetId. Distance ties retain the first target.

previewOnly.description: For scanEdit fillHoles mode bridge only: return the generated facet strip as a JSON artifact and continuity diagnostics without changing geometry or history. Requires one start boundary in indices and explicit start/end edge indices; endBoundary optionally selects a different closed loop or open chain. Omit selectionOnly, createNew and targets.

name: alignment_references
description: Read exact CAD face or fitted primitive alignment references without changing geometry or history. Returns paged points, directions and display triangle ranges in mm. Unsupported surfaces are explicit. This read-only native job uses job_get/job_cancel; use fresh results after any model edit. Optional triangleIndex resolves the exact face picked in the canvas.

name: alignment_preview
description: Preview object coordinate alignment from one to three native plane/direction/point constraints. Targets are unlocked meshes, point clouds or exact CAD bodies. Ordered constraints build the reference frame; its rigid inverse transforms scans. Exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement and retains exact topology. Model/history stay unchanged; preview_discard target datum restores the committed scene and releases temporary CAD handles. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD/fitted inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

translation.description: Optional X/Y/Z offsets in mm along the constructed reference frame basis, applied before rigid inversion. Defaults to no offset.

translationPoint.description: Optional picked world point in mm. Resolve it in the current source-reference frame and replace translation with those offsets; the picked point becomes the aligned origin.

parallel.description: Enable bounded CPU worker execution for large scans (default true); false uses cancellable serial chunks with identical native arithmetic.

name: alignment_apply

Scan indexed topology and saved selections are preserved; exact CAD uses verified OpenCascade axis-frame placement, retains BRep topology and preserves fitted primitive parameters with verified native transforms and clears stale authoring/display-selection metadata. Same constraints as alignment_preview; source geometry is checked before commit. Cancellation releases temporary CAD outputs; committed source/result handles remain valid for Undo/Redo. Optional translation is in reference-frame axes (mm), not world axes. Constraints may bind reference IDs returned by alignment_references; exact CAD/fitted inputs are read again from the current revision. Large scans use bounded CPU workers when admitted; each target reports execution diagnostics and serial fallback reason. Source-scan references are retained and reported even when stale fitting patches are cleared. Nonidentity CAD placement retains authoringLinks identity and resolved references when clearing its stale recipe. Include dependent recipes and every output of each affected authoring feature; incomplete groups fail before CAD allocation. Identity placement retains the original recipe. Point-cloud alignment retains immutable local buffers and composes the verified double pose; pointCloudPose in each target is its exact little-endian Float64 hex frame. World geometry remains available through object_get. Rendering retains GPU buffers; derived world bounds/views may use bounded CPU workers. Binary project format 3 deduplicates local cloud buffers through history; older format 2 remains readable.

name: landmark_preview
description: Solve the active picked-point session through the GUI preview worker without committing geometry or history. Returns a job; poll job_get. Raw indexed moving scans use native coarse registration, seeded region growth and refinement against indexed scans or exact CAD fixed targets. CAD conversion reuses kernel face triangulations, evaluates analytic D1 positions and normals at their UV nodes, and preserves the BRep. Publishes coarse registration, refinement, diagnostics and markers through landmark_get. Moving point clouds retain their point type, immutable local buffers, normals and composed native double pose; large world-view transforms use at most two CPU workers. Their paired solve sends only picked coordinates to its worker. Cancel through job_cancel or preview_discard targeting landmarks. Refinement uses the session targetScope; visibleScene orders visible evaluated CAD roots before visible indexed scans, excludes superseded CAD inputs using authoring dependency update order, excludes the moving scan, and preserves the fixed geometry. Hidden evaluated consumers still suppress their CAD inputs; exempt construction primitives alone do not. Cyclic authoring dependencies are rejected. With no eligible refinement surfaces, an indexed moving scan retains coarse alignment and native grown selection, reports an accepted identity refinement with the native maximum-float error sentinel, and uses one physical worker without creating a correspondence pool. A successful ordinary preview contains one native matrix and locks repeat preview until landmark_edit action reset; reset retains picked points. This check occurs before CAD resolution or worker allocation.

name: landmark_accept
description: Accept the current picked-point preview through the GUI commit operation. Requires an unchanged, unlocked source and target and a valid preview. Creates one model history step, preserves the fixed target and closes the session. Use a fresh revision and request ID after the preview job completes.

name: landmark_get
description: Read the active picked-point alignment session, original world-coordinate picks, transformed preview markers and preview lock state, with coarse registration, refinement and execution diagnostics when a preview exists. Point-cloud previews also expose pointCloudPose as a little-endian Float64 frame. Also reports optional fixedId (null for all references) and captured referenceIds. Does not mutate geometry or history. Reports canPreview, canReset, canRemove, candidateCount and candidateIndex for the ordinary native single-matrix preview state.

name: landmark_edit
description: Begin or edit the shared picked-point alignment session. Begin requires movingId; fixedId is optional and filters reference picking. With no fixedId, fixed points may come from any visible selectable unlocked reference in the captured scene. reference-target binds fixedId or clears it when omitted, resets picks and preview, and defaults cleared binding to visibleScene. pick requires entityId and a world-coordinate point in mm. Picked coordinates are rounded to native Float32 precision and stored as doubles; values outside the finite Float32 range are rejected. After preview, picking is rejected and removal/clear are no-ops; reset removes the preview and retains original picks. These edits do not create model history. Use landmark_preview to solve, landmark_accept to commit, and preview_discard to close/cancel. Begin defaults to visibleScene refinement against visible evaluated exact CAD roots and other visible indexed scans; fixedId is an optional canvas picking filter. Use targetScope fixed for single-target refinement. action target-scope changes scope and resets preview while retaining picks. landmark_get reports targetScope and refinementTargetIds. Scene geometry/order/visibility changes invalidate a scene-target preview. Point clouds are not mesh-facet refinement targets. Moving clouds use coarse registration and retained native poses. Complete original point-cloud dialog admission and workflow parity remain unverified.

fixedId.description: Optional reference picking filter. Omit at begin for all captured visible references. With action reference-target, omission clears the filter and resets picks and preview.

targetScope.description: Begin defaults to visibleScene: visible exact CAD first, then other visible indexed scans in scene order. fixed preserves single-target refinement. target-scope changes this choice and resets preview while retaining picks.

name: interactive_alignment_get
description: Inspect the active Interactive scan-alignment session: version, Double poses, pivot, measured bounds, drag strength, mirror options, source readiness and worker diagnostics. No geometry transfer.

name: interactive_alignment_edit
description: Begin or edit Interactive alignment for one to 32 unlocked visible mesh/point-cloud scans. Preview uses display poses and leaves authored geometry/history unchanged. Later edits require the latest sessionId and expectedSessionVersion. Strength is percent; step angles are degrees and translations mm; axes are 0=X/1=Y/2=Z. Drag translation/rotation handles use normalized top-left viewport points, including captured points outside the viewport. Mirror is a mesh-only visual reference across XY/YZ/XZ. Apply separately or cancel with preview_discard target interactive.
